data.name: Ayrika
data.gender_notes: Ayrika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ayuh’ meaning ‘life’ and ‘Rik’ meaning ‘Goddess’. Ayrika is the goddess who bestows the blessings of long and healthy life. She is also associated with creativity, beauty, and joy. The name Ayrika carries the meaning “Goddess of Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayrika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayrika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayrika total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
